title: GridapGeosciences.jl: A Julia finite element package for partial differential equations on general manifolds
summary: We present GridapGeosciences$.$jl, a new parallel distributed-memory Julia package for the numerical approximation of partial differential equations on general manifolds. Our abstract approach to generating discrete manifold domains relies on mesh refinement in general, and is implemented within the Gridap finite element library, whose high-level interface enables seamless definition of both intrinsic and extrinsic variational formulations.
